name: Urza's tower
description: Urza's tower is the tower Urza built as his workshop, later the Coalition's base on Dominaria.

summary.text: Urza's tower is the tower Urza built as his workshop, later the Coalition's base on Dominaria.

bio.text: Urza built the tower as his workshop.
Teferi climbed its stairs, remembering his mentor and his late wife Subira.

status.text: The latest pages show the tower defended by Nissa and Wrenn and attacked by Phyrexians, with Teferi lying in the coffin there; the material gives no event for its fate.

timeline.summary: Saheeli leads Teferi to her device in Urza's tower, where he resolves to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.
timeline.quote: Teferi would do the one thing he had vowed never to do: cross time itself.

timeline.summary: Teferi climbs the stairs of Urza's Tower, remembering his mentor and his late wife Subira.
timeline.quote: Teferi reached the top of the stairs, where he paused to catch his breath

timeline.summary: Jodah gives Teferi Kjeldoran biscuits made by Saheeli's construct, and Teferi asks him to lead while he is away on the time machine.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to consider being that person.

timeline.summary: Elspeth asks where Ajani is and Teferi tells her; she reacts with grief and silence.
timeline.quote: Where is Ajani?

timeline.summary: Kaya briefs the group on the plan: the other planes are mobilizing and the Coalition will join Koth's Mirrans in assaulting the Phyrexian core.
timeline.quote: Without a head, the body will fail.

timeline.summary: Elspeth calls the plan a death sentence and storms out.
timeline.quote: That's a death sentence,

timeline.summary: Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
timeline.quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

timeline.summary: Kaya suspects the Phyrexians have repurposed the World Tree of Kaldheim, which could join every plane.
timeline.quote: This is the World Tree of Kaldheim.

timeline.summary: Vivien names Tezzeret as the intermediary who arranged her audience, and Kaya objects strongly.
timeline.quote: You know what he did on Ravnica!

timeline.summary: Saheeli shows Teferi her perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex

timeline.summary: Saheeli gives Teferi a clockwork peafowl and says the Anchor will be ready that night.
timeline.quote: The Anchor will be ready to use tonight.

timeline.summary: Teferi confesses to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war and calls himself the true heir to Urza's mantle.
timeline.quote: Then I siphoned energy from the closed portal to fuel a spell spiriting Zhalfir away from space and time itself.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi she is not here to absolve him.
timeline.quote: I am not here to provide you absolution, mage.

timeline.summary: Elspeth apologizes to Teferi, and he tells her about Ajani's compleation.
timeline.quote: I was there with him when it happened—when the compleation took hold.

timeline.summary: Teferi shares mitab fruit with Elspeth and tells her that everything he does is about saving his daughter Niambi.
timeline.quote: Everything I'm doing is about saving her .

timeline.summary: Elspeth offers to stay and defend them, and Teferi welcomes her.
timeline.quote: If you'll have me.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's sword glows and Teferi recalls his father's story of the wattle-eyes, choosing to believe.
timeline.quote: This time, Teferi chose to believe.

timeline.summary: Kaya extends her ghostform over the coffin while Saheeli powers up the Temporal Anchor in a test, but the circuitry fails in a shower of sparks.
timeline.quote: A shower of sparks poured out from a bank of circuitry

timeline.summary: Saheeli finds the wiring torn apart, and Kaya shields her from an explosion, with both sensing a melancholy presence hovering nearby.
timeline.quote: extending her ghostform to protect them both from the explosion

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies a black crystal orb from Teferi as the cause and wants to know why it creates ghosts.
timeline.quote: a black crystal orb encased in a cage of silver

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Kaya find Jodah speaking with Jhoira, who asks if Teferi is still bent on going back in time.
timeline.quote: He's still bent on going back?

timeline.summary: Kaya explains the orb is strengthening a lingering spirit through a silver cord of psychic energy.
timeline.quote: I saw a silver cord extending from the orb to the spirit.

timeline.summary: Jodah recognizes Urza's work in the orb and reveals Urza was the tower's builder, Teferi's teacher and his ancestor.
timeline.quote: Teferi's teacher. And my ancestor.

timeline.summary: Jodah reveals Thran script in the orb's cage reading, Go back to the beginning and greet me properly.
timeline.quote: It's the written language of the Thran, an ancient civilization on this plane,

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Kaya spring a trap that gives the spirit a semblance of solidity using the rhythm of Gonti's heart.
timeline.quote: Saheeli's trap worked!

timeline.summary: The spirit shoves Saheeli aside, hacks the anchor with a ghostly blade and flees; Kaya pursues.
timeline.quote: The blade struck the anchor, gouging a deep gash into its side.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Jodah find Kaya facing the spirit, who gives his name as Sharaman, the leader of Urza's armies.
timeline.quote: General Sharaman,

timeline.summary: Sharaman says he acts to prevent Urza's war machine restarting and recounts losing his nephews to Mishra's dragon engines and the sacking of Sardia.
timeline.quote: I will not let anyone repeat the mistakes I made.

timeline.summary: Kaya lunges at Sharaman in her ghostform and kills him, then kneels shaken; he asked if he would see his family again and she said he would.
timeline.quote: she activated her ghostform and lunged at the spirit

timeline.summary: Saheeli begins the final run with Teferi in the coffin and Kaya in position.
timeline.quote: Saheeli switched on the anchor.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, unable to sleep, drills in the tower's grand hall and admits her skills feel sluggish after New Capenna.
timeline.quote: But after all her experiences on New Capenna, her movements had felt sluggish, her sword arm shaky.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Elspeth she lives two melodies, one in light and one in shadow, and Elspeth angrily denies it.
timeline.quote: It is as if you live two separate lives. One in light, one in shadow.

timeline.summary: Wrenn senses visitors, and Elspeth confronts two figures glowing green in the rain.
timeline.quote: Are you Elspeth?

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra arrive at the tower and Elspeth hands them to Kaya for debriefing.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar walked into the light.

timeline.summary: At a watchtower, Elspeth sets up one of Saheeli's cylinder turrets and tries to pray, remembering that Ajani is compleated.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled a steel-clad cylinder from her sack

timeline.summary: Elspeth speaks quietly to Giada about her hatred for the Phyrexians and her failures.
timeline.quote: And I hate them so much for what they did to Ajani.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jodah, drinking in the hall, toast and reminisce about the dead Jaya.
timeline.quote: Let me have one turn on Saheeli's time machine, and I'd go back

timeline.summary: Elspeth joins them and speaks of Venser; Jodah reveals he is four thousand years old, and Chandra vows to save Ajani and burn the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: We're going to save him.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes the mechanical garrison and clay brutes and sets them in defense arcs.
timeline.quote: All at once, the hundred or so mechanical soldiers stomped to life

timeline.summary: Jodah unveils a staked trench and fire to impale the Phyrexian vanguard, and Elspeth and Jodah charge with powerstone lances that unleash scything bands of energy.
timeline.quote: Jodah unwove the phantasmal terrain spell he'd cast the previous day

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights through the horde with her sword and Halo, then orders the mechanical legion to charge.
timeline.quote: Upon hearing the command word, the metal legion defending the keep turned into aggressors

timeline.summary: The skyship unfolds into a giant legged behemoth heading for the tower.
timeline.quote: Several more gargantuan legs sprouted from the bottom of the skyship's hull

timeline.summary: Jodah leads Elspeth in casting Jaya's spell, and she channels her hope of saving Ajani, producing a blaze that destroys the behemoth.
timeline.quote: A column of radiance poured out of her

timeline.summary: Rona appears, blasts Elspeth and Jodah with lightning, and stabs Jodah in the gut as revenge for Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: This is for the trouble you caused me in Yavimaya,

timeline.summary: Elspeth wounds Rona with her sword, though her arm is run through by the glaive.
timeline.quote: burying her sword deep into Rona's shoulder.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives, spares Elspeth, tells her to disappear before the tower falls, and carries off Rona.
timeline.quote: I suggest you take this opportunity to find somewhere remote and disappear.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra discuss the situation with Kaya and Saheeli: Jace's alliance is gathering and the Mirrans are about to attack.
timeline.quote: Jace has it on good authority that the Mirrans are going to launch their offensive very soon,

timeline.summary: Kaya explains the Phyrexians' World Tree plan and says they need the sylex to destroy it.
timeline.quote: If the Phyrexians have created their own tree, we'll need something powerful to destroy it,

timeline.summary: Chandra says no cost is too high to destroy the Phyrexians, clashing with Nissa and Saheeli.
timeline.quote: My point is that destroying the Phyrexians is the most important thing. No cost is too high.

timeline.summary: Teferi appears and says he is ready, and Chandra later admits she wants all Phyrexians to die.
timeline.quote: I want them all to die. All of them.

timeline.summary: At night Nissa, Wrenn and construct guardians hold the tower hall against Phyrexians who cross the threshold.
timeline.quote: Over two dozen Phyrexians had met with similar fates in the tower hall

timeline.summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

timeline.summary: A second army of white-armored Phyrexians led by a flying winged general advances from the east.
timeline.quote: Out of the haze emerged a battalion of knights, more than a hundred strong

timeline.summary: Nissa commands the mechanical soldiers to meet the army, but nature spirits refuse her call and leylines are tangled.
timeline.quote: They recoiled at her presence.

timeline.summary: The constructs and Phyrexians clash, and the Phyrexians fight with unusual tactics, pinning the machines.
timeline.quote: The armies collided with sharp staccato thunderclaps.

timeline.summary: Nissa lends Wrenn and Seven her strength and Seven hurls her at the flying Phyrexian general, whom she stabs repeatedly with a seed-bearing sword.
timeline.quote: With each stab, she'd implanted a seed within the Phyrexian

timeline.summary: Nissa and the general fall, Seven catches her, but she is dragged down by Phyrexians and reaches into the ground for the Worldsoul, Gaea.
timeline.quote: Help! Help us! she called out

timeline.summary: Gaea's nature spirits call Nissa a meddler, then judge her and grant her power, filling her with the wrath of Gaea.
timeline.quote: Gaea has judged you

timeline.summary: Gaea's will transmutes fallen constructs and Phyrexians into heartwood warriors that pour onto the battlefield and push back the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gaea's would-be destroyers now reassembled themselves

timeline.summary: Nissa kills the crippled Phyrexian general with vines, after Wrenn urges her to stop, deciding she must be decisive when the time comes.
timeline.quote: The vines obeyed her command.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

timeline.summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
timeline.quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

timeline.summary: Jodah and Elspeth stagger in alive; Elspeth announces she will go to New Phyrexia and Jodah will stay to free Teferi.
timeline.quote: Then I'm coming with you.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

timeline.summary: Jace links the strike team telepathically, and Nissa finds a tiny artifact bird, resolving to keep watch for every plane.
timeline.quote: For the life of every plane,

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR, Teferi lies in a metal coffin and signals Kaya that he is ready to send his spirit back in time after a month of testing.
timeline.quote: Teferi knocked twice on the inside of the lid. He was ready.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Kaya and Saheeli plan how to find the true sylex's activation, and Teferi picks The Antiquities War as the key text, aiming for the Last Battle on Argoth.
timeline.quote: We go here—the last battle of the Brothers' War.

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls his wound from a Phyrexian creature and that the Phyrexians are at the chamber doors.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexian creature had wounded him deep

timeline.summary: Teferi explains Saheeli's insight: send only a spirit back, since silver travel would be like dousing oneself in lamp oil.
timeline.quote: By extracting one's spirit and casting that back, one would be unable to interact with the past while remaining able to observe

timeline.summary: Back in the present, Teferi tells Kaya and Saheeli he has found blotted time, while the anchor may not survive another trip.
timeline.quote: I saw it, like a scar. Part of the tapestry blotted out, like ink spilled on a page.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns sick and tells the others he almost has it, then goes back for one last attempt as Kaya warns it is brutal.
timeline.quote: Last one,

relations.note: Urza built the tower as his workshop.
relations.quote: Urza built this tower to be his personal workshop

pages_say.description: The ancient tower where Saheeli's device waits and Teferi prepares to cross time.
Urza's well-preserved tower in a mist-shrouded Argivian vale, now the Coalition's base.
The tower on Dominaria where the Coalition works.
The open tower on Dominaria that the Coalition holds.
The tower Nissa and Wrenn defend.
The tower where Teferi lies in the coffin and the Phyrexians attack.
